text: In an elementary topos the subobject classifier $\Omega$ is the 'object of truth values.' In the topos $\mathbf{Set}$, what is $\Omega$?
explanation: In $\mathbf{Set}$ every subobject $A\hookrightarrow B$ is the preimage of 'true' under a characteristic map $B\to\{0,1\}$, so $\Omega=\{0,1\}$ carries the two classical truth values. The empty set classifies nothing; the terminal object $1$ is the source of the map $\top:1\to\Omega$, not $\Omega$ itself; and $\mathbb{N}$ is the separate natural number object.
